action.name: Pre-held-out V1 A1 common-scale gate
action.objective: Researcher freezes one candidate-neutral common A1 scaling history for CS2 attribution, declines comparative A1 claims, or closes V1 without held-out access.
prerequisites: PO-C OF4 materialization complete and checksummed
No A1 loss or candidate ranking inspected
A6 and G5 remain V1 non-estimable and not executed
forbidden_scope: A1 CS2 SR0-to-SR1 computation or interpretation
candidate-specific denominator substitution for common-support attribution
action.completion_condition: Researcher selects and explicitly authorizes a bounded pre-held-out disposition.
mandatory_stop_conditions: Any attempt to infer scale history from OF4 results
Any A6 G5 or held-out access
Any mutation of immutable OF4 ancestors
